about_the_game:
VoxMagic - GPU Acceleration DLC

Unleash the full potential of your voice and experience unprecedented real-time voice changing speed!

This DLC adds GPU acceleration support to VoxMagic (currently NVIDIA GPUs only), delivering significant performance improvements:

  • Dramatically reduced latency: from approximately 1 second down to around 400ms (actual results depend on your GPU).

  • Lower CPU usage: frees up processor resources for smoother multitasking.

  • Smoother real-time voice changing: enjoy instant and natural voice effects while gaming, streaming, or chatting.

Enable GPU acceleration and make your voice creations faster, more stable, and more exciting!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: 1.66 GHz Intel i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / RTX 2060，CUDA Compute Capability ≥ 3.5
  • Storage: 4096 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Intel i7 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / 4060
  • Storage: 4096 MB available space

short_description: Boost your voice in real time with GPU acceleration! Dramatically lower latency and reduce CPU load (NVIDIA GPUs only).
